Validation: `go test ./...`, `git diff --check`, and `ostf check --base main` passed; all 113 links are valid.

- Added links: `Cart.VolumeDiscount`, `Checkout.PlaceOrder`, `PriceWithVolumeDiscount`, and `TestPlaceOrderVolumeDiscount` to `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT`. No new items.
